frame.anchor_translation: existing sealed materialization; no re-anchoring or target-dependent transform

metrics.absolute_progress_m: initial target distance minus final target distance; positive is distance reduction.
metrics.best_progress_m: initial target distance minus minimum target distance.
metrics.endpoint_error_m: norm(decoded final XYZ - expert final XYZ); not target distance.
metrics.endpoint_target_vector_cosine: cosine(decoded endpoint displacement, target vector from decoded start).
metrics.final_target_distance_m: Euclidean decoded final EEF position to target; target distance, not expert error.
metrics.minimum_target_distance_m: minimum target distance over decoded trajectory.
metrics.position_rmse_m: RMSE of decoded-vs-expert XYZ over H40.
metrics.prediction_path_length_m: sum of decoded successive XYZ segment norms.
metrics.roughness_ratio: mean decoded XYZ second-difference norm divided by expert XYZ second-difference mean; dimensionless.

paired.delta: left minus right on the same window_id/target/seed/tier key
paired.exposure: @2000 versus @1000 within the same route and seed: 9 comparisons.
paired.intervention_vs_legacy: L1 or N2 versus Legacy at the same tier and seed: 12 comparisons.
paired.l1_vs_n2: L1 versus N2 at the same tier and seed: 6 comparisons.
